description_expanded: Tucked inside the private, gated community of Cypress Dunes , Coastal Serenity is a thoughtfully designed 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom beach retreat that sleeps up to 8 guests. Surrounded by natural beauty and upscale amenities, this vacation home balances luxury with comfort, creating the ideal setting for your next coastal getaway. With two king bedrooms, a queen guest room, and a cozy bunk room for the kids, everyone will find their perfect space to relax. Two separate living areas—one with a queen sleeper sofa—offer plenty of room to spread out, and a separate sitting area with a dedicated desk makes it easy to work remotely, if needed. The heart of the home is its bright and open main living space, where ten-foot ceilings and wide-plank wood floors create an airy, elevated feel. A mantle adds warmth to the living room, while the adjacent dining area flows seamlessly into a professional-grade kitchen equipped with marble countertops, a six-burner gas stove, and top-tier stainless steel appliances—everything a chef could ask for. Step outside to enjoy not one, but two welcoming porches, including a large screened-in back patio surrounded by peaceful greenery, ideal for laid-back dinners or morning coffee in the shade. When it’s time to unwind or explore, you’ll find an abundance of resort-style amenities just steps from your door. Cypress Dunes offers two gorgeous pools, including a seasonally heated infinity-edge pool with unobstructed Gulf views, as well as a jetted hot tub, tennis courts, and a well-equipped fitness center. Stroll the community’s elevated boardwalks and nature trails (be sure to check out the Cypress pond), or take the 6-seater golf cart or one of the four included bikes to the nearby Beach Highlands neighborhood beach access—just a 5- to 7-minute ride away. The community also features a second-level sundeck, an outdoor fireplace, and scenic views of Topsail Hill Preserve State Park. Centrally located along the quieter west end of 30A, Coastal Serenity puts you within easy reach of the area’s best dining, shopping, and outdoor recreation. Just next door, you’ll find the main entrance to Topsail Hill Preserve State Park —home to miles of secluded shoreline, coastal dune lakes, and scenic hiking and biking trails through unspoiled natural landscapes. Grab brunch or fresh Gulf seafood at local favorites like Stinky’s Fish Camp , browse the boutiques at Grand Boulevard , or spend a day cruising the Timpoochee Trail that stretches all the way to Rosemary Beach. Whether you’re craving outdoor adventure or simple relaxation, this prime location has something for everyone. From peaceful mornings on the porch to sunny afternoons by the pool or beach, Coastal Serenity offers the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and coastal charm. Come make this Cypress Dunes escape part of your family’s tradition. First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Hall Bath with Walk-in Shower, Queen Bedroom, Kitchen, Dining, Second Living Area with Queen Sleeper Sofa, Laundry Second Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In-Shower, Bunk Room with Shower/Tub Combo, King Bedroom with Shower/Tub Combo *Wristbands need to worn at the Pool, Tennis Courts, and Clubhouse and Guests will be charged $100 for each lost Wristband.
